jobs.title: AI/ML Engineer
jobs.jd: About the Singapore AI Center of Excellence (COE) The Singapore AI Center of Excellence (COE) is a dedicated engineering and R&D hub focused on Enterprise and Sovereign AI. Our mission is to help organizations move AI workflows cleanly into production through two main paths: creating reusable software architectures that solve common industry problems, and contributing code directly to upstream open-source projects to fix enterprise gaps in system deployment, runtime tuning, and platform management. Basing our engineering team in Singapore creates a close feedback loop between customers, partners, and core product teams. This direct connection keeps our development roadmaps relevant, speeds up solution delivery, and strengthens our ability to co-innovate across the region. Role Overview The AI/ML Engineer is a highly technical, hands-on role at the intersection of Enterprise AI and client-facing architecture. As part of our Customer Engineering function, you will write production-grade solution blueprints alongside strategic customers and technology partners. Your mission is to solve immediate, high-stakes operational bottlenecks in the APAC region by delivering repeatable, extensible, and open-sourced AI Quickstarts that show the industry how to solve complex challenges. In this team, career growth and seniority are defined purely by your technical competence, architectural depth, and ability to deliver end-to-end solutions autonomously in highly ambiguous environments. There is no expectation of team management, project coordination, or formal talent mentorship; your progression is driven entirely by engineering impact. What You Will Do: Enterprise-Minded Blueprinting: Design and build comprehensive, production-ready architecture blueprints and reference codebases. These blueprints must naturally take into account critical enterprise requirements—including systems-level hardening, infrastructure scalability, and network isolation boundaries—without you needing to perform the last-mile hands-on production deployment yourself. Open-Source AI Quickstarts: Package repeatable, extensible technical architectures as open-sourced AI Quickstarts to solve complex, real-world industry problems and accelerate ecosystem adoption. Co-Development & Integration: Collaborate with external engineering teams (such as semiconductor partners, regional AI programs, and software vendors) to validate joint-architecture blueprints, ensuring stable integrations across the system stack. Benchmarking & Evaluation: Design and integrate automated testing, evaluation harnesses, and system-level telemetry into blueprints to monitor and measure performance metrics like latency, throughput, cost, and model quality. Regulated & Secure Design: Proactively incorporate robust data privacy standards, secure network perimeters, and localized hosting considerations into all solution blueprints to satisfy compliance and risk management requirements in highly regulated environments. What You Will Bring: Academic & Professional Experience Education: Bachelor’s or Master's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related quantitative field. Software Engineering Foundations: Excellent understanding of software engineering fundamentals, including clean code principles, test-driven development (TDD), CI/CD automation pipelines, and version control (Git) workflows. Communication: Clear verbal and written communication skills in English, with the ability to articulate complex technical architectures to other engineers and technical stakeholders. Core Technical Stack Programming Languages: Exceptional, hands-on proficiency in Python (specifically for machine learning and systems programming). Solid familiarity with lower-level system languages such as Go or C/C++ is highly preferred. Deep Learning & ML Libraries: Strong familiarity with PyTorch and core NLP/vision ecosystems (e.g., Hugging Face Transformers, datasets, and tokenizers). Cloud-Native Frameworks: Strong practical experience deploying containerized applications on Kubernetes or production-grade enterprise container orchestration platforms. Base MLOps Knowledge: Conceptual and hands-on understanding of model serving lifecycles, data ingestion steps, and automated packaging. Target Knowledge Domains & Growth Areas We are building a multi-disciplinary engineering squad. Candidates are expected to bring experience in some of the following domains, and will have the opportunity to continuously develop their skills across all of them as they grow in seniority: Platform & Pipeline Engineering: Experience with distributed computing frameworks and cluster schedulers (such as Ray), workflow orchestration (such as MLflow or Kubeflow), distributed unstructured data parsing tools (such as Docling), and vector database structures. Generative AI & Agentic Architectures: Familiarity with LLM orchestration engines (such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, or LangGraph), agentic workflows (AgentOps), tool-calling protocols (such as Model Context Protocol) and model fine-tuning (PEFT/SFT). Hardware Heterogeneity & Runtime Optimization: Understanding of model serving runtimes (such as vLLM), optimizing engines for latency and throughput (e.g., KV cache offloading, chunked prefill), and running benchmarks across diverse hardware setups including CUDA, ROCm, and emerging GPU/NPU architectures. Regulated Deployments: Designing isolated, air-gapped container networks, secure registry services, and local inference environments to meet strict data residency, privacy, and compliance policies. Nice-to-Have: Industry Domain Experience While not strictly required, experience applying AI/ML architectures to solve challenges in the following regulated industries is a strong advantage: Financial Services (FSI): Familiarity with risk-assessment models, fraud detection patterns, or compliance requirements under regulatory frameworks. Public Sector & Healthcare: Experience handling highly sensitive or anon

With 100,000+ active communities and approximately 130 million daily active unique visitors, Reddit is one of the internet’s largest sources of information. From “How do I fix a leaky faucet?” to “What should I watch next?”, the Answers Relevance team leverages AI to connect people with the real-world wisdom of Reddit communities. jobs.title: Medior AI Engineer
jobs.jd: Van slimme AI-modellen naar oplossingen die écht werken. Een AI-model bouwen is één ding. Zorgen dat het betrouwbaar draait, gekoppeld is aan echte data en waarde toevoegt bij een klant: daar wordt het interessant. Bij adesso werk je aan AI-oplossingen die verder gaan dan experimenten, van machine learning en MLOps tot generatieve AI, LLM's en agents. Je bouwt, implementeert en verbetert oplossingen die organisaties echt gebruiken. Wat ga je doen? Als Medior AI Engineer werk je samen met senior AI Engineers en Forward Deployed Engineers aan klantprojecten. Je pakt zelfstandig onderdelen op en groeit in architectuur en end-to-end verantwoordelijkheid. AI ontwikkelen: je bouwt ML-modellen, LLM-toepassingen en agentic workflows. Van idee naar productie: je bouwt data- en ML-pipelines, automatiseert deployments en zorgt voor monitoring en betrouwbaarheid. Slim integreren: je koppelt AI aan bestaande systemen, API's en cloud- en dataplatformen. Meedenken met de klant: je vertaalt vraagstukken naar praktische, schaalbare oplossingen. Kennis delen: je legt herbruikbare patronen vast en deelt wat je leert met je collega's. Projecten die verder gaan dan het model We richten ons op retail en e-commerce, finance en utilities. Denk aan: Prognoses waar planners op durven te sturen, van retailassortiment tot netbelasting. Intelligente documentverwerking, zoals KYC-dossiers of inspectierapporten, met herleidbare bronnen. Agents die werk voorbereiden in klantenservice en backoffice, met evals en guardrails. Computer vision, zoals in de fitnessbranche, waar we onveilige situaties in onbemande 24/7-locaties herkennen. De uitdaging zit niet alleen in het model, maar ook in betrouwbaarheid, integratie en de werking in de praktijk. Je kiest steeds de techniek die bij het probleem past. Wat breng je mee? Ervaring met het ontwikkelen en in productie brengen van ML- of GenAI-oplossingen. Goede kennis van Python, SQL en machine learning. Ervaring met MLOps en/of LLM's, RAG en AI-agents. Kennis van minimaal één cloudplatform (Azure, AWS of GCP) en een dataplatform zoals Databricks, Snowflake of Fabric. Je werkt met coding agents en beoordeelt kritisch wat ze opleveren. Je denkt vanuit de klantvraag en legt technische keuzes helder uit. Je spreekt en schrijft vloeiend Nederlands en Engels. Wat dit níet is Geen individuele detachering. Je werkt aan projecten namens adesso, met een team achter je. Geen notebook-kerkhof. Een model is pas af als het in productie draait en gebruikt wordt. Geen GenAI omdat het kan. Soms is een klassiek model beter, soms een LLM; jij kiest wat past. Geen werk op afroep. Je denkt vanaf de klantvraag mee, niet pas als het ontwerp al vastligt. Het team Je wordt onderdeel van ons AI Engineering-team: AI engineering consultants in twee rollen. De Forward Deployed AI Engineer (FDE) is eigenaar van het klantprobleem en ontwerpt de oplossing, inclusief de agentic architectuur. Jij gaat als AI Engineer de diepte in op bouw, data, MLOps en schaal, en denkt vanaf de klantvraag mee over de juiste aanpak. Je krijgt ruimte om je eigen werk vorm te geven, maar je bent nooit alleen verantwoordelijk voor alle specialismen. Heb je diepe kennis van finance, retail of utilities en wil je dichter op de klant zitten? Kijk dan ook naar onze FDE-vacatures. Twijfel je? Solliciteer dan gewoon; we kijken samen welke rol het best past. Waarom adesso? Omdat je bij ons écht kunt meebouwen. Bij adesso Nederland draait het om meer dan alleen technologie. We bouwen slimme oplossingen die daadwerkelijk waarde toevoegen voor onze klanten. Geen eindeloze experimenten of AI omdat het hip is, maar technologie die werkt en impact maakt. We zijn onderdeel van de internationale adesso Group, met ruim 11.500 collega's op meer dan 60 locaties. Tegelijkertijd zijn we in Nederland een relatief klein en persoonlijk team, met korte lijnen, veel vrijheid en ruimte voor eigen initiatief. Groot genoeg om impact te maken, klein genoeg om het verschil te voelen. AI-native: wij omarmen AI, ook in ons eigen werk We geloven dat AI fundamenteel verandert hoe we software bouwen, met data werken en klanten helpen. Daarom bouwen we niet aan losse experimenten, maar aan dataplatformen, AI-first applicaties en agentic oplossingen die echt onderdeel worden van bedrijfsprocessen. Dat geldt ook voor hoe we zelf werken. Met onze Agentic Delivery-aanpak en eigen tools kun je echt vliegen: Context en kennisbank: agents werken met wat er écht speelt bij de klant, en kennis en beslissingen blijven herleidbaar voor mens én agent. AgentOps en governance: zicht op wat agents doen en controle over wat ze mogen, zodat ze veilig en binnen de regels werken. adSCAILE: ons eigen framework waarmee je samen met AI-agents bouwt, geïntegreerd, veilig en traceerbaar, in cycli van twee tot vier dagen in plaats van sprints van weken. Je gebruikt deze tools dagelijks en helpt ze verder te ontwikkelen. adesso is bovendien Select Partner in het Claude Partner Network van Anthropic. En we blijven kritisch: niet alles hoeft met AI. De beste oplossing staat altijd voorop. En misschien wel het belangrijkste: de mensen Je komt terecht in een team waar vakmanschap, ondernemerschap en kennisdeling centraal staan. Je werkt met ervaren specialisten en groeit richting architectuur en end-to-end verantwoordelijkheid. We houden van collega's die nieuwsgierig zijn, kennis delen en elkaar verder helpen. Mensen die goed zijn in hun vak, maar ook plezier hebben in samenwerken. Je krijgt bij ons vertrouwen, verantwoordelijkheid en de vrijheid om ideeën daadwerkelijk uit te voeren. Wat krijg je van ons? €4.950–€6.050 bruto per maand op basis van 40 uur 8% vakantiegeld Contract voor 32 tot 40 uur per week Een mobiliteitsvergoeding bovenop je salaris 27 vakantiedagen en 4 studiedagen €3.600 persoonlijk ontwikkelbudget per jaar en ruimte voor certificeringen Hybride werken met flexibele werktijden Goede pensioenregeling Doorgroeimogelijkheden Internationale kennis en ontwikkelmogelijkheden, gec

jobs.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.jd:
Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? At Coinbase, we are uncompromising on our mission to increase economic freedom. The bar is high, the environment is intense, and we like it that way. This isn't a place for complacency, it’s a place to be pushed past your perceived limits. If you're ready to build the future of finance alongside people who refuse to settle for "good enough," you belong here. Coinbase is a remote-first, but not remote-only company. Expect to get together quarterly for intense in-person working sessions called “surges.” Learn more about working at Coinbase.

The ML & Discovery team in Consumer Growth builds the machine learning systems that help millions of customers discover what to trade and engage with next across crypto, equities, derivatives, and prediction markets. Our models and platforms power personalized feed and asset ranking, intelligent notification orchestration, and LLM-driven market insights across the Coinbase app. As a Senior Machine Learning Engineer (L5) you will own end-to-end initiatives across the ML lifecycle, from problem formulation, feature engineering, and modeling to production serving and online A/B experimentation. Partnering closely with Product, Data Science, and Engineering in a high-velocity, data-driven environment, you will shape our team's roadmap, raise our engineering quality bar, and use AI-native workflows to deliver measurable business impact.

What you’ll do: 

  • Own end-to-end machine learning initiatives from problem formulation and offline evaluation to production deployment and online A/B testing, driving measurable lifts in user engagement, retention, and trading activity.
  • Build and iterate on multi-stage recommendation, retrieval, and contextual bandit models that serve personalized experiences to millions of users across crypto, equities, derivatives, and prediction markets.
  • Design intelligent notification orchestration, candidate ranking, and targeting systems that match users with timely, high-value alerts while avoiding fatigue and improving user experience.
  • Develop production LLM pipelines, grounding workflows, and automated evaluation loops that generate accurate, real-time market insights and personalized financial content.
  • Architect resilient, low-latency model serving services and real-time feature pipelines, eliminating technical debt, leading incident response, and raising our operational reliability bar.
  • Partner with Product, Data Science, and Engineering to shape the team roadmap, mentor L3-L4 engineers, and build AI-native workflows and automation that multiply team velocity.

Required Skills and Experience:

  • 5+ years of experience in machine learning engineering and software development, with a track record of shipping production ML systems that move customer and business metrics.
  • Proven track record in one or more relevant domains: recommendation systems, multi-stage ranking and retrieval, contextual bandits, notification targeting, or production LLM applications.
  • Strong software engineering and data skills in a backend language like Python or Go, with hands-on proficiency in modern ML and data stacks (such as PyTorch, GBDTs, Spark/Databricks, Ray, Kafka, and/or Tecton).
  • Deep practical knowledge of offline model evaluation, training-serving skew mitigation, and design/interpretation of online A/B experiments tied to business metrics.
  • Demonstrated ability to drive complex projects end-to-end, make pragmatic architectural trade-offs, and mentor junior engineers.
  • Utilizes generative AI responsibly, maintaining human oversight to deliver business-ready outputs and drive measurable improvements in workflow efficiency, cost, and quality.

jobs.title: Applied AI Engineer, Digital Natives
jobs.jd: About the Team OpenAI’s Applied AI Engineering team helps organizations turn frontier AI capabilities into safe, reliable, and high-impact production systems. We work with customer executives, product and engineering teams, security leaders, and transformation teams to identify valuable opportunities, accelerate technical implementation, and scale what works. Enterprise deployments are defined by complexity rather than any one industry: existing architectures, diverse data environments, security and governance requirements, multiple stakeholder groups, and organization-wide change. We turn lessons from these deployments into better products and reusable patterns for customers everywhere. About the Role As an Applied AI Engineer, you will partner directly with Digital Native companies to design, build and deploy AI-powered products and systems. Working alongside customer product and engineering teams, you will take ideas from early experimentation through evaluation, production launch and scale, connecting technical decisions to user experience and measurable business impact. jobs.title: Senior AI Engineer
jobs.jd: Jij zet AI-projecten op vanuit de inhoud en leidt ze tot een tevreden klant. Een sterk model bouwen is één ding. Een klant laten zien wat AI voor hem kan doen, de juiste oplossing bedenken en die betrouwbaar in productie krijgen: dat is jouw vak. Als Senior AI Engineer combineer je diepgang in machine learning en MLOps met diepgang in generatieve AI, LLM's en agents. Je bent erbij vanaf het eerste klantgesprek en bent als delivery lead eindverantwoordelijk voor de oplevering. Wat ga je doen? Nieuwe projecten opzetten: van eerste gesprek tot proposal, met steun van sales. Je inspireert de klant vanuit de inhoud, bedenkt de oplossing en zet een degelijke projectplanning neer. De oplevering leiden: als delivery lead doe je het projectmanagement, geef je dagelijks leiding aan de uitvoering en voer je het stakeholdermanagement. Technische keuzes maken en meebouwen: je ontwerpt de architectuur van data-, ML- en agentsystemen en bouwt zelf mee. Met een FDE in het team werk je het agentic ontwerp samen uit. Naar productie en draaiend houden: MLOps, monitoring, security en onderhoudbaarheid zijn bij jou geen bijzaak. Het team optillen: je begeleidt collega's en helpt standaarden te ontwikkelen. Projecten die verder gaan dan het model We richten ons op retail en e-commerce, finance en utilities. Denk aan: Prognoses waar planners op durven te sturen, van retailassortiment tot netbelasting. Intelligente documentverwerking, zoals KYC-dossiers of inspectierapporten, met herleidbare bronnen. Agents die werk voorbereiden in klantenservice en backoffice, met evals en guardrails. Computer vision, zoals in de fitnessbranche, waar we onveilige situaties in onbemande 24/7-locaties herkennen. De uitdaging zit niet alleen in het model, maar ook in betrouwbaarheid, integratie en de werking in de praktijk. Wat breng je mee? Diepgang in ML engineering en MLOps én in GenAI, LLM's en agents, met oplossingen die je zelf in productie hebt gebracht en onderhouden. Je ontwerpt de architectuur van data-, ML- en agentsystemen, met oog voor evals, monitoring, security en de EU AI Act. Sterk in Python en SQL, en hands-on met minimaal één cloud (Azure, AWS of GCP) en een dataplatform zoals Databricks, Snowflake of Fabric. Ervaring met business development én als delivery lead of projectleider. Je werkt dagelijks met coding agents en beoordeelt kritisch wat ze opleveren. Je spreekt en schrijft vloeiend Nederlands en Engels. Wat dit níet is Geen individuele detachering. Je werkt aan projecten namens adesso, met een team achter je. Geen notebook-kerkhof. Een model is pas af als het in productie draait en gebruikt wordt. Geen GenAI omdat het kan. Soms is een klassiek model beter, soms een LLM; jij kiest wat past. Geen werk op afroep. Je denkt vanaf de klantvraag mee, niet pas als het ontwerp al vastligt. Het team Je wordt onderdeel van ons AI Engineering-team: AI engineering consultants in twee rollen. De Forward Deployed AI Engineer (FDE) is eigenaar van het klantprobleem en ontwerpt de oplossing, inclusief de agentic architectuur. De AI Engineer gaat de diepte in op bouw, data, MLOps en schaal, en denkt vanaf de klantvraag mee over de juiste aanpak. Je krijgt ruimte om je eigen werk vorm te geven, maar je bent nooit alleen verantwoordelijk voor alle specialismen. Twijfel je welke rol het best bij je past? Solliciteer dan gewoon; we kijken samen. Waarom adesso? Omdat je bij ons écht kunt meebouwen. Bij adesso Nederland draait het om meer dan alleen technologie. We bouwen slimme oplossingen die daadwerkelijk waarde toevoegen voor onze klanten. Geen eindeloze experimenten of AI omdat het hip is, maar technologie die werkt en impact maakt. We zijn onderdeel van de internationale adesso Group, met ruim 11.500 collega's op meer dan 60 locaties. Tegelijkertijd zijn we in Nederland een relatief klein en persoonlijk team, met korte lijnen, veel vrijheid en ruimte voor eigen initiatief. Groot genoeg om impact te maken, klein genoeg om het verschil te voelen. AI-native: wij omarmen AI, ook in ons eigen werk We geloven dat AI fundamenteel verandert hoe we software bouwen, met data werken en klanten helpen. Daarom bouwen we niet aan losse experimenten, maar aan dataplatformen, AI-first applicaties en agentic oplossingen die echt onderdeel worden van bedrijfsprocessen. Dat geldt ook voor hoe we zelf werken. Met onze Agentic Delivery-aanpak en eigen tools kun je echt vliegen: Context en kennisbank: agents werken met wat er écht speelt bij de klant, en kennis en beslissingen blijven herleidbaar voor mens én agent. AgentOps en governance: zicht op wat agents doen en controle over wat ze mogen, zodat ze veilig en binnen de regels werken. adSCAILE: ons eigen framework waarmee je samen met AI-agents bouwt, geïntegreerd, veilig en traceerbaar, in cycli van twee tot vier dagen in plaats van sprints van weken. Je gebruikt deze tools dagelijks en helpt ze verder te ontwikkelen. adesso is bovendien Select Partner in het Claude Partner Network van Anthropic. En we blijven kritisch: niet alles hoeft met AI. De beste oplossing staat altijd voorop. En misschien wel het belangrijkste: de mensen Je komt terecht in een team waar vakmanschap, ondernemerschap en kennisdeling centraal staan. Je werkt met ervaren specialisten en groeit door in technische visie en in verantwoordelijkheid voor klantrelaties. We houden van collega's die nieuwsgierig zijn, kennis delen en elkaar verder helpen. Mensen die goed zijn in hun vak, maar ook plezier hebben in samenwerken. Je krijgt bij ons vertrouwen, verantwoordelijkheid en de vrijheid om ideeën daadwerkelijk uit te voeren. jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE), Cyber - NYC
jobs.jd: About the team OpenAI’s Forward Deployed Engineering team builds with customers to bring frontier AI into production. Our Cyber FDEs partner with the security and engineering teams that defend globally critical systems, from enterprise software to the core infrastructure it runs on. Cyber FDEs work closely with our Product, Research, and Go-to-Market teams to adapt our products and models to what customers need to defend their systems. About the role You’ll build systems that give defenders an advantage at a scale few engineering teams encounter. You might help an enterprise identify, test, and deploy patches across hundreds of thousands of code repositories, or help a security team analyze petabytes of logs for signs of malicious agents or coordinated attacks. Across these deployments, you’ll build tools that customer engineers can trust to support consequential security decisions. You’ll work directly with customer security teams, from CISOs to frontline analysts. As AI changes how attackers operate, you’ll help these teams determine where their defenses need to evolve, prioritize what to build, and validate solutions with the engineers who will operate them. Alongside OpenAI’s account teams, you’ll translate security priorities into deployed systems that help defenders cover more ground. You’ll also help shape what OpenAI builds next. When you identify a gap between what defenders need and what today’s models or products can do, you’ll partner with Research and Product to define, build, and test capabilities that address it. This role is based in New York. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week. We offer relocation assistance. Travel up to 50% is required. In this role you will: - Partner with customer security leaders and OpenAI’s Go-to-Market team to scope engagements, establish responsibilities, and define measurable success criteria. - Lead technical design and implementation alongside customer engineers. Integrate agents into security workflows, establish access boundaries, and determine which actions require human review. - Build evaluations grounded in the decisions defenders make. For a patching agent, test whether a fix blocks a known exploit while preserving expected application behavior. For a detection system, replay historical attacks alongside normal traffic to measure detection speed and false-positive rates. - Guide production rollout with the engineers who will operate the system. Provide the observability and controls they need to understand system behavior, intervene when necessary, and expand adoption with confidence. - Translate successful approaches across deployments into reusable tools and engineering practices that other defenders can adopt. You might thrive in this role if you: - 5+ years of software engineering experience, including building and shipping production software. - Experience protecting production systems through work in security engineering, infrastructure, SRE, DevOps, or product engineering. - Experience building and evaluating AI agents for software engineering workflows. - Experience with CI/CD pipelines and practices that maintain code quality, reliability, and security. - Ability to navigate unfamiliar codebases and contribute maintainable, production-quality changes. - Ability to communicate technical concepts and trade-offs to engineering teams and senior security stakeholders. Additional experience Cybersecurity spans many disciplines, and while we’re primarily looking for strong engineering generalists, we’d love to hear about deeper experience in any of the following areas: - Security curiosity and experimentation: You read CVE write-ups because you want to understand how things break. You may have built an agent honeypot to test a hypothesis—or prove a point—and enjoy turning a security question into a hands-on experiment. - Security community engagement: You enjoy exchanging ideas with defenders, whether that’s discussing security strategy with a CISO at Black Hat or comparing technical approaches with frontline practitioners. - Application security: You’ve written CodeQL queries or Semgrep rules, built fuzzing harnesses, or discovered and responsibly disclosed vulnerabilities. - Automated remediation: CI/CD is your happy place. You’ve built tooling that turns security findings into tested patches, dependency upgrades, or configuration changes across large codebases. - Detection engineering: You’ve written and deployed detections using Sigma, YARA, Splunk, or KQL and tested them against attacker behavior. - Cloud and identity security: You’ve designed cloud IAM architectures and investigated abuse of workload identities, role hierarchies, or cross-account trust. - Security research: You’ve reverse-engineered malware, developed exploit reproductions, or contributed to vulnerability research. - Agent security: You’ve tested agents for prompt injection, tool misuse, or credential exposure and built defenses against them. jobs.title: Senior Applied Scientist, Leo Space Security
jobs.jd: Amazon Leo is a constellation of Low Earth Orbit satellites that will provide low-latency, high-speed broadband network connectivity to unserved and underserved communities around the world. We are looking for an Applied Scientist to be a founding scientist on the Engineering and R\&D team within Leo Infrastructure and IP Security. The team defends the manufacturing lines, launch sites, and global ground infrastructure behind the constellation from the most sophisticated threat actors on the planet. These requirements create open scientific problems at the intersection of agentic AI, real-time stream processing, graph-based reasoning, and behavioral analytics. You will build the science behind a neurosymbolic reasoning platform and the models that detect the behavior of sophisticated threat actors. This is an R\&D role with a production mandate, where you define the problem rather than solve a pre-scoped one, and every model, detection, and agent workflow you build becomes the system Leo's security teams use to protect the constellation. #### Export Control Requirement Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen. Key job responsibilities - Design and implement scalable, production-grade neurosymbolic systems that integrate symbolic reasoning over graph-based knowledge representations with LLM agents to deliver reliable, verifiable security outcomes. - Design and run reinforcement learning and fine-tuning pipelines (GRPO, PPO, DPO) to optimize language models for security reasoning, triage, and detection-authoring tasks. - Build behavioral and statistical models that detect threat actor behavior, and design the evaluation frameworks that measure model performance against that behavior before trusting a model in production. - Design and build multi-agent systems that autonomously triage, enrich, and contain security events, including the constrained reasoning, safety guardrails, and validation mechanisms that make automated decisions trustworthy at scale. - Own the end-to-end science lifecycle, from research and experimentation through production deployment, defining the metrics that measure system performance and real-world security impact. - Advance the state of the art through publications at top-tier venues, patents, or open-source contributions, and shape the scientific agenda and research culture from day one. A day in the life You will move between research and production in the same week: framing an ambiguous security problem as a scientific question, prototyping an approach, and partnering with software engineers to ship it as a capability the platform runs continuously. Security engineers on your team translate threat intelligence into the adversary behaviors that matter; you build the models that detect those behaviors and evaluate model performance against them. You will obsess over the two latencies that define the platforms, the time from event to detection and the time from detection to containment action, and design agents and detections that drive both down. You will backtest candidate detections against retained telemetry, review evaluation results before a model or agent capability graduates to automated execution, and deliver scientific artifacts that ship. About the team Leo Infrastructure and IP Security protects the people, facilities, hardware, and supply chain behind a global satellite constellation. The Engineering and R&D team within this organization builds the platforms and tooling the security pillar teams operate on, moving security operations from manual triage to correlation-based detection, automated response, and agentic AI. The team is composed of applied scientists, software engineers, and security engineers working across physical and digital security domains. #### Inclusive Team Culture In Amazon Security, it's in our nature to learn and be curious. Ongoing DEI events and learning experiences inspire us to continue learning and to embrace our uniqueness. Addressing the toughest security challenges requires that we seek out and celebrate a diversity of ideas, perspectives, and voices. #### Training & Career Growth We're continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth's Best Employer. That's why you'll find endless knowledge-sharing, training, and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional. #### Work/Life Balance We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there's nothing we can't achieve. - 3+ years of building machine learning models for business application experience - PhD, or Master's degree and 6+ years of applied research experience - Experience programming in Java, C++, Python or related language - Experience with neural deep learning methods and machine learning - - Experience with graph algorithms, knowledge graphs, unsupervised learning (clustering, dimensionality reduction, anomaly detection), NLP, and embedding-based retrieval - - Experience designing evaluation frameworks for AI systems where ground truth requires human judgment, including staged rollouts, A/B testing, and expert feedback loops - Experience with modeling tools such as R, scikit-learn, Spark MLLib, MxNet, Tensorflow, numpy, scipy etc. - Experience in building quantitative solutions as a scientist or science manager - Experience in one or more of the following domains: access- control system and methodology, network security, application- and system-development security, security architecture and models, cryptography, and operations security - - Experience with terabyte-scale stream processing and real-time correlation of heterogeneous event sources - - Experience with cost and latency optimization for LLM-based systems (token reduction, schema optimization, determinist

About Telnyx

Telnyx is an industry leader that's not just imagining the future of global connectivity—we're building it. From architecting and amplifying the reach of a private, global, multi-cloud IP network, to bringing hyperlocal edge technology right to your fingertips through intuitive APIs, we're shaping a new era of seamless interconnection between people, devices, and applications.

We're driven by a desire to transform and modernize what's antiquated, automate the manual, and solve real-world problems through innovative connectivity solutions. As a testament to our success, we're proud to stand as a financially stable and profitable company. Our robust profitability allows us not only to invest in pioneering technologies but also to foster an environment of continuous learning and growth for our team.

Our collective vision is a world where borderless connectivity fuels limitless innovation. By joining us, you can be part of laying the foundations for this interconnected future. We're currently seeking passionate individuals who are excited about the opportunity to contribute to an industry-shaping company while growing their own skills and careers.

 

 

The Role

We're building a local Enterprise Sales Pod in Munich — one AE and one Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE), working together to build a Telnyx enterprise business in your market. You'll embed directly with enterprise customers to architect and ship production systems on Telnyx's global network — voice, messaging, AI, and wireless.

This isn't about demoing products. It's about building real solutions that work at scale.

You'll work side-by-side with a dedicated Enterprise AE — not a demo resource, but a commercial partner who owns the named-account list, builds executive relationships, and closes the deal. You own the technical side: discovery, architecture, POC, and production go-live. You win together. No throw-over-the-wall.

The Pod Model

Enterprise AE — owns the named-account list, builds executive relationships, gets in the room, owns commercial qualification and close, expands the account. .

Forward Deployed Engineer — owns technical discovery, designs the architecture, builds the POC when gated, gets the first workload live, removes blockers and finds the next workload.

We sell the workload, not the SKU. Customers buy a production outcome — an AI contact center, a SOC/NOC agent, global communications, connected mobility, or enterprise inference — that runs on Telnyx primitives (voice, messaging, numbers, wireless, Voice AI, inference, agents, connectivity). You lead with the outcome conversation, not a product menu.

What You'll Do

• Embed with enterprise customers to understand their communications workflows, AI use cases, and integration challenges firsthand
• Build and deploy custom implementations: AI Voice Assistants, Telnyx APIs (Voice, Messaging, Fax, Wireless), WebRTC
• Run open-weight LLMs in customer environments — consume GLM, Kimi, DeepSeek, Qwen, and MiniMax through Telnyx Inference (OpenAI-compatible API; there's no model infrastructure for you to run), or deploy self-hosted stacks (Llama, Mistral, and region-specific models like Aleph Alpha's Luminous, or sovereign EU models) behind your own serving engine when air-gapped or sovereign-cloud requirements demand it
• Deploy and operate LiteLLM as the model gateway in customer environments: a unified OpenAI-compatible interface across self-hosted open-weight models and hosted providers, with routing, load balancing, retries and fallbacks, rate limits, and per-team virtual keys
• Instrument and govern LLM usage through the gateway — cost tracking and budgets, caching, logging and observability (OpenTelemetry, Langfuse, or similar), and guardrails — so customers can see and control what their AI workloads are doing
• Wire production observability for everything you ship — metrics, logs, traces, dashboards, and alerting (e.g. Prometheus + Grafana for metrics, OpenTelemetry for traces, Graylog or ELK for logs — or the customer's existing stack) — so you and the customer's ops team both know what "healthy" looks like and what pages whom when it isn't
• Design model routing strategies for real-time voice workloads, balancing latency, cost, and quality, with sane fallback behavior when a provider degrades
• Make the build-vs-buy case between self-hosted open-weight models and hosted frontier APIs, and keep the customer's application code portable across both
• Adapt models to customer domains: prompt and RAG pipelines and evaluation harnesses for German-language use cases and DACH-specific regulatory environments (GDPR, EU AI Act, German data localization)
• Lead POCs, pilots, and production launches from whiteboard to go-live
• Own customer outcomes — stay engaged until the solution is live and stable
• Collaborate directly with Product and Engineering to shape the roadmap based on field insights from Germany, Austria, and Switzerland
• Create clear technical documentation, runbooks, and maintainable solutions for handoff

jobs.jd: Are you passionate about pushing the boundaries of what robots can do? Your work will directly influence how automation systems learn, adapt, and perform at Amazon's scale — and you will see your research come to life on real hardware. A day in the life You might start your morning reviewing overnight training runs, analyzing reward curves and failure modes from your latest reinforcement learning experiments. After a quick sync with robotics engineers, you shift to refining a simulation environment to close a gap you spotted between sim and real performance. In the afternoon, you pair with a teammate to design a new evaluation framework, then wrap up by drafting a short write-up of your findings to share with the broader team. We combine reinforcement learning, physics-based simulation, and hands-on hardware validation to deliver solutions that work beyond the lab. We value intellectual curiosity, collaborative problem-solving, and a shared commitment to turning ambitious research ideas into tangible impact. If you are excited about building intelligent systems that learn from experience and operate at scale, this is the team for you. - Master’s degree or higher in a relevant field such as Engineering, Robotics, or Machine Learning. - A minimum of five years of industry or research experience, with PhD experience applicable. - Strong deep learning fundamentals, including supervised and self-supervised learning techniques, and reinforcement learning, including Markov Decision Processes (MDPs), neural network architectures, policy optimization algorithms, model-based vs. model-free RL, exploration-exploitation strategies, value function methods, transfer learning, domain adaptation, sim-to-real transfer, etc. - Strong background in robotics including autonomy and/or manipulation. - Experience with deploying artificial neural networks on hardware platforms. - Ability to write production-level code in modern C++. - Ability to prototype algorithms and train deep neural networks in Python. - Strong background in robotic manipulation, including dynamics, grasp synthesis, and trajectory optimization. - PhD degree in Robotics, Engineering, Computer Science, Machine Learning or a similar discipline, or an equivalent amount of research experience. - Publications at top-tier conferences (e.g., ICRA, IROS, CoRL, RSS) specifically focusing on robotic manipulation, grasping, or contact-rich RL. - Demonstrated experience working with tactile sensing, multi-fingered robotic hands, or bimanual manipulation. As a Sr Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) you will work with customers to build and productionize solutions to their data & AI challenges using the Databricks platform. You will own the architecture, lead design decisions, and implement end-to-end systems spanning data engineering, AI, and application development. We work cross-functionally to shape long-term strategic priorities and initiatives alongside engineering, product, and developer relations. FDEs deliver with customer empathy, integrating with client systems, training, and other technical needs to help customers get most value out of their data. 

This is a hands-on, customer-facing role for builders who thrive at the intersection of technology and business impact. The ideal candidate combines engineering expertise with adaptability, curiosity, and a passion for working with customers and teammates to solve complex problems that drive measurable outcomes. FDEs are billable and know how to complete projects according to specification with exceptional customer empathy.

The impact you will have:

  • Production Solution Delivery: Lead impactful customer technical projects by delivering production-grade systems, designing and building reference architectures, custom applications and data ingestion and ML/AI model integration
  • Transformational Impact: Guide strategic customers as they implement transformational big data projects including end-to-end design, build and deployment of industry-leading big data and AI applications. Work with engagement managers to scope technical delivery work with input from the customer
  • Empower Customers: Guide customers on architecture and design; bootstrap or implement customer projects which leads to a customers' successful understanding, evaluation and adoption of Databricks.
  • Own the Architecture: Lead architecture and design decisions, ensuring solutions are secure, scalable, and aligned with both customer needs and Databricks best practices.
  • Work with the Databricks technical team, Project Manager, Architect and Customer team to ensure the technical components of the engagement are delivered to meet customer's needs.
  • Work with Engineering and Databricks Customer Support to provide product and implementation feedback and to guide rapid resolution for engagement specific product and support issues.
  • Customer Immersion: Embed with customer teams, engaging with stakeholders from technical ICs to executives to deeply understand challenges and deliver impact.
  • Reusable Assets & Scale: Contribute accelerators, frameworks, and best practices that scale impact across accounts and influence the Databricks product roadmap.

What we look for:

  • 6+ years experience in data engineering, data platforms & analytics, or software engineering
  • Comfortable writing code in either Python, Scala, JavaScript/TypeScript, and modern frameworks
  • Working knowledge of two or more common Cloud ecosystems (AWS, Azure, GCP) with expertise in at least one
  • Deep experience with distributed computing with Apache Spark™ and knowledge of Spark runtime internals
  • Familiarity with CI/CD for production deployments
  • Working knowledge of MLOps, ML/AI models and AI APIs
  • Design and deployment of performant production end-to-end data architectures and applications that combine data pipelines, ML/AI models, and user-facing interfaces.
  • Experience with technical project delivery - managing scope, timelines and measurable outcomes, translating complex concepts into actionable solutions.
  • Documentation and white-boarding skills.
  • Experience working with enterprise clients and managing conflicts across a broad stakeholder range

  • Travel to customers 20% of the time
  • Databricks Certification

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineering Lead
jobs.jd: TL;DR – We're looking for a Forward Deployed Engineering Lead to help scale the future of AI-powered software creation. You'll build and lead the FDE team and partner with our most ambitious customers to turn ideas into real products. This is still a hands-on role: you'll design, write, and ship production code alongside your team, while partnering with our other FDE leaders to shape how the function operates globally. It's a unique opportunity to scale a new discipline from scratch and solve problems that no one has solved before. Why Lovable? Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. From solopreneurs to small business owners to teams at companies like Adidas and Zendesk, people have built over 60 million projects on Lovable since its launch in November 2024. And we're just getting started. We're building a generational company from Stockholm, with growing teams in London, Boston, New York, and San Francisco. Our team is small, talent-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world. Lovable is one of TIME's 100 Most Influential Companies and has been recognized on the Forbes AI 50 and CNBC Disruptor 50, reflecting our momentum as one of Europe's fastest-growing AI companies and one of the most ambitious places to build in this next era of software. About the role Most engineering leadership roles move you away from the code. This one keeps you close to the craft and the customer. You'll build, develop, and lead a team of Forward Deployed Engineers who partner with our customers at the frontier of what Lovable can do, solving hard technical problems across our frontend, backend and AI systems. The goal isn't just to make individual deployments succeed. It's to spot what should become part of the Lovable platform and act on it. As one of a small group of FDE leaders, you'll set the technical bar for the function and help define how it scales, from its engineering standards and ways of working to how it works with customers and our core product teams. If you want to build an exceptional engineering team without stepping away from building yourself, this is that role. What we're looking for - 12+ years across software engineering, technical architecture, and customer-facing engineering - Experience leading and developing high-performing technical teams - A track record of remaining deeply hands-on as your leadership scope has grown - Strong full-stack engineering fundamentals, including React and TypeScript on the frontend and robust backend development - Strong architectural thinking and familiarity with distributed systems - Experience owning complex technical engagements end-to-end - Exceptional product intuition and ability to work directly with users - Ability to move comfortably between writing code, making architectural decisions, leading engineers, and working with senior stakeholders - Comfort operating with high ambiguity, agency, and velocity Bonus if you've: - Scaled a team or technical function from zero - Worked on agentic AI systems or built with LLMs in production - Led zero-to-one product development - Worked in a founding or early startup environment - Worked across high-growth startups, big tech, consulting, or enterprise AI What you'll do - Build, develop, and lead a team of Forward Deployed Engineers - Work directly with customers to understand their workflows, needs, and hardest technical problems - Design, prototype, and implement solutions alongside your team - Own and guide projects end-to-end, from discovery and architecture through shipping and iteration - Set the technical bar through architecture decisions, code reviews, and hands-on engineering - Translate insights from customer deployments into foundational platform improvements - Partner with other FDE leads to shape the function's engineering standards, rituals, and playbooks as it scales globally - Contribute to core product strategy, technical decisions, and cultural foundations Our Tech Stack - Backend: Golang & Rust - Frontend: React, TypeScript - Cloud: Cloudflare, GCP, AWS, multiple LLM providers - Tooling: GitHub Actions, OTEL, Grafana, Terraform, and more About your application - Please submit your application in English - it's our company language - We treat all candidates equally - if you're interested please apply through our careers portal

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.jd:
As a Forward Deployed Engineer at Auterion, you will play a pivotal role in the successful development, integration and deployment of Auterion-powered drone systems. 

In this role, you will collaborate closely with the production, hardware engineering, and firmware/software teams, as well as operations, ensuring that every platform transitions smoothly from an airframe concept into a fully validated flying robot ready for deployment. You will serve as the primary technical interface for partners, work closely with them to understand their technical requirements, configure and adapt existing solutions, contribute to core software development, and ensure successful implementation. 

This role is ideal for an engineer who enjoys combining hands-on technical work with customer collaboration and system-level problem solving, bridging the gap between hardware, firmware, and real-world flight performance. 

Responsibilities and Duties

  • Operate in a highly hands-on environment with evolving system requirements, rapidly iterating across hardware and software integration challenges.
  • Manage software releases and perform firmware flashing and configuration using PX4 or adjacent autopilot ecosystems, including sensor calibration, ESC tuning, and system bring-up.
  • Provide deep avionics and airframe expertise, including autopilot tuning, sensor and payload integration, power systems and airworthiness considerations.
  • Work independently to troubleshoot integration and flight-readiness issues while collaborating cross-functionally with hardware engineering, firmware/software teams, operations, and QC engineering to escalate complex challenges when required.
  • Act as the primary technical authority in customer engagements, translating mission requirements into concrete system architectures and demonstrable solutions built on AuterionOS and Skynode.
  • Participate in flight testing activities to validate platform stability, safety, and mission performance, resolving technical issues often directly in the field during customer trials and demonstrations.
  • Contribute to technical documentation and continuous improvement of engineering processes.
  • Feed customer and market requirements back into product and engineering teams to influence the roadmap of the Auterion stack.

Qualifications and Skills

  • Degree in Software, Electrical, Mechanical, Aerospace or Robotics Engineering, or a related field
  • Working proficiency in C/C++ and Python: you can read, debug and patch existing code and write small tools and scripts
  • Comfortable in Linux environments, including the command line, logs, Docker and basic networking (IP, TCP/UDP)
  • Hands-on hardware-software integration: system bring-up, wiring and connectors, and embedded interfaces (UART, CAN, I2C, SPI) at a practical level
  • Structured troubleshooting: you can isolate whether a problem is software, hardware, configuration or RF, often under time pressure in the field
  • Strong communicator: you can explain technical issues clearly to customers and operators, and report findings back to engineering in a way they can act on
  • Willing to travel and work on-site with customers, including at test ranges and in field environments
  • EU citizenship (required for security clearance and customer requirements)

Nice-to-have

  • Experience with PX4 or ArduPilot, MAVLink, QGroundControl or mission planning tools
  • UAV flight testing and validation in operational environments
  • Experience with datalinks and radio systems
  • Previous customer-facing or field engineering role, especially with defense or government customers
  • German language skills

Benefits

  • Flexible working hours
  • Stock Options
  • Generous holiday allowance
  • Pension plan 
  • Extended social security package 
  • Enhanced maternity & paternity leave

About Auterion

We are building the leading software platform for AI-powered autonomous systems for enterprise and government customers. Our team is supporting the most important missions and solving the most challenging problems.

At Auterion, we bring together the sharpest minds who love to solve the hardest problems. Join a vibrant team built on innovation, openness, and excellence, where you’ll be empowered to develop ideas, collaborate across all levels, and make an impact that matters.

jobs.title: AI Engineer l Young Talent Program
jobs.jd: The rules of building are being rewritten. Come write them with us. Every few decades, the way companies are built gets reinvented from scratch. That is happening right now, and the people who learn to build in this new world first will define the next twenty years. Superstars are being made this year, not in ten. HelloPrint is a €100M+ e-commerce company serving businesses across Europe and the US. We are rebuilding the entire company as AI-first: our platform, customer service, operations, and how we design, price, sell, and deliver. Every piece of technology we run is being rewritten as we speak. We are doing it with a small, senior, very fast AI development team working shoulder to shoulder with our business leads. Now we are opening a handful of seats for young builders who want to grow faster than any graduate scheme, bootcamp, or big-tech ladder could ever let them. We don't care if you are 16, 25 or 30, whether you are self-taught, hacking in high school, or finishing a degree at TU Delft or TU/e—we care about what you have built and how fast you solve hard problems. The HelloPrint AI Residency is how you start. It is a permanent role from day one: your first year is a structured residency where you rotate across our most important AI projects, build alongside the team and learn at full speed. After that, you keep growing - in the direction where you have the most impact. What you will actually do: You will not get a training plan, a sandbox project or six months of shadowing. From week one, you build real things that real customers and colleagues use, on the projects that matter most to the company. You sit next to the founders, next to the engineers who are rebuilding our platform, and next to the business leads who own the outcomes. You get a lot of freedom and real responsibility, plus honest, direct guidance and feedback from people who have built this before. The kind of work you could be on in your first months: Agentic Commerce : making HelloPrint discoverable and orderable through AI assistants, so a customer can order business cards from inside a chat. AI Design Studio : letting customers create a print-ready design from a single sentence. AI-first customer service : replacing classic ticketing with agents that resolve questions, check artwork and handle orders end to end. Internal agent swarms : automating finance, purchasing, pricing and operations work that today still takes people hours. Whatever you spot next : if you see something we should build, you pitch it, and if it is good, you build it. We work with almost every modern framework and model, and we change our tools the moment something better appears. You will ship, measure, throw away and ship again - every week. Who you are: You are a builder before anything else . You have shipped things nobody asked you to build: an app, an agent, a bot, a tool your friends actually use, a side business, an open-source contribution, a weird experiment that taught you something. You probably have more GitHub commits, demos or deployed projects than most people twice your age. You are extremely curious and extremely critical. You read the new model release the day it drops and try it that evening. You question every assumption, including ours, and you can explain why. You are never satisfied with "it works" — you want to know why it works, and how it could be ten times better. You want to get better every single day, and you treat feedback as fuel rather than criticism. You take ownership: when something breaks, you fix it; when something is unclear, you go and find out. You have a solid grasp of backend and software fundamentals (Python, APIs, databases) or the raw learning capacity to pick them up in weeks. You will probably recognise yourself in most of this: You build with AI every day: Claude, Cursor, Lovable, agents, APIs, whatever gets you there fastest. You can show us concrete proof of work, not just tell us about it. You move fast without being sloppy, and you care about the details the customer sees. You are comfortable not knowing the answer, and you find it quickly. You communicate clearly in English, in writing and out loud. What we do not require: a degree, a minimum age, years of experience or a perfect CV. If you are still in school or university, we will make it work around that. What you get: The honest pitch: you will learn more here in one year than in five years almost anywhere else , because you will be building real systems for a real company that is reinventing itself, with the people who are leading that change. A contract from day one. The Residency is your first year at HelloPrint, not a trial period or an internship. Direct access to the founders and to a senior AI development team who review your work and push you. Ownership from day one : your name on projects that change how a €100M+ company runs. The best tools, no budget debates : the newest models, coding agents and frameworks, as soon as they are worth using. A growth path that follows your output, not your age : if you outgrow your role in six months, your role grows with you. A fast, flat, no-politics team in Rotterdam, with a hands-on culture and a high bar. Flexible set-up : full-time, or part-time alongside your studies. We care about what you deliver. Salary and contract are tailored to your situation and your level, and we pay properly for real talent. How to apply: Skip the cover letter. Show us what you have built. Send us three things: Your best project : a link to something you built: a live product, a repo, a demo video. Tell us in a few sentences what it does and what you would do differently now. Something you think is broken : one thing about HelloPrint (our website, our ordering flow, anything) that you would rebuild with AI, and how you would do it. A short intro : who you are and what you are obsessed with right now. Five sentences is plenty. What happens next: We read every application ourselves and reply within 5 days

jobs.jd: Robots are about to step out of the movies and into our homes. If you're excited about this robotics revolution, come join Amazon's Fauna Robotics. As an Applied Scientist in this org, you'll push the state-of-the-art techniques in Robotics. You'll drive technical excellence in areas such as perception, manipulation, sim2real transfer, reinforcement learning and multi-task learning, designing novel algorithms that bridge the gap between research and real-world deployment. In this role, you will integrate hands-on technical expertise with scientific leadership, ensuring your team delivers robust solutions for dynamic real-world environments. While staying updated with the latest advancements in robotics research, you will leverage your experience and expertise to guide the team towards the most promising direction. Collaborating with a talented group of software engineers and scientists, you will bring your ideas to fruition. Deploying robots in home environments requires you to anticipate challenges not encountered in structured settings like warehouses. Additionally, consumer-grade sensors and actuators necessitate working around their limitations, requiring out-of-the-box innovative ideas. As such, you are someone who truly enjoys thinking about problems using first principles at a holistic and systems level to address the aforementioned challenges. Key job responsibilities - Lead technical initiatives in areas such as robotics foundation models, reinforcement learning and manipulation - - Design experiments to identify the limitations of current state-of-the-art models and developing new models or techniques that can surpass these models - Design and implement novel deep learning architectures that push the boundaries of what robots can understand and accomplish - Mentor fellow scientists while maintaining strong individual technical contributions - Collaborate with engineering teams to optimize and scale models for real-world applications - Influence technical decisions and implementation strategies within your area of focus - Experienced in communicating complex technical work to a non-technical audience - The ability to work with minimal guidance, be proactive and to handle ambiguity and the challenge of quickly evolving goals About the team Fauna Robotics, an Amazon company, is building capable, safe, and genuinely delightful robots for everyday life. Our goal is simple: make robots people actually want to live and interact with in everyday human spaces. We believe that future won’t arrive until building for robotics becomes far more accessible. Today, too much effort is spent reinventing the fundamentals. We’re changing that by developing tightly integrated hardware and software systems that make it faster, safer, and more intuitive to create real-world robotic products. Our work spans the full stack: mechanical design, control systems, dynamic modeling, and intelligent software. The focus is not just functionality, but experience. We’re building robots that feel responsive, expressive, and genuinely useful. At Fauna, you’ll work at the frontier of this space, helping define how robots move, manipulate, and interact with people in natural environments. It’s an opportunity to solve hard problems across hardware and software with a team focused on making robotics accessible and joyful to build. Location: Sydney

As a Forward Deployed Strategist (FDS), you are the critical bridge between a customer's multi-million dollar business problem and Databricks' technical solution. You are a product manager for the field, owning the entire non-technical lifecycle of an FDE engagement.

You will partner with our Account Executives to build C-suite trust, perform deep discovery to map the customer's political and technical landscape, and, most importantly, scope the value. You will define the Minimum Viable Product for a pilot, write the PRD that guides the engineering team, and manage the project to a successful landing.

This role requires a rare mix of C-suite gravitas, deep product-style thinking, and a hands-on, get it done execution mindset.

The impact you will have:

  • C-Suite Scoping & Value Definition: Partner with Sales to perform deep discovery, map the customer's organization, quantify the business value ($10M+ problems), and define the pilot (MVP, success criteria, timeline).
  • End-to-End Product Ownership: Act as the CEO of the project by authoring the PRD, prioritizing the engineering backlog, relentlessly managing scope, and acting as the primary hands-on QA tester.
  • Agile Project Execution & Delivery: Drive the FDE build team via an agile process, manage all stakeholder communications from the C-suite to individual engineers, and act as the escalation manager to unblock all technical or political issues.
  • Solution Launch & Landing: Own the Day 0 launch, manage the war room, and drive the solution from launch to full adoption by capturing user feedback, iterating, and proving the defined business value.
  • Strategic Handoff & Growth: Scope the ongoing maintenance plan, create customer documentation/training, and leverage your trusted advisor status to identify the next high-value FDE engagement.

What we look for:

  • Executive Presence & Communication: A Trusted Advisor with C-suite gravitas and superb communication skills. You are opinionated, humble, and can build rapport and drive decisions in days, not weeks.
  • Product & Strategy Mindset: A Product Thinker and Systems Thinker who can perform a SWOT analysis, understand a competitive landscape, and define what to build and why.
  • Relentless Execution: An Execution Driver with a Hands-On mentality. You are relentless, an expert at escalation, and willing to do the unglamorous work to get the project done.
  • Ideal Experience: 2+ years as a Deployment Strategist OR 2+ years at a high-growth startup in a builder or founder capacity. (Alternatively: 5+ years in a senior, client-facing product or delivery role at a top-tier tech company or consultancy).
  • Proven Skills: Demonstrated experience in value-based scoping (TCO/ROI), managing agile software projects, writing PRDs, and the ability/interest to travel up to 50%.

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer – SAP (m/f/d)
jobs.location: Berlin, with travel across DACH Germany
jobs.jd: About Qorelo Almost every company running SAP faces the same task: the move to SAP S/4HANA. These programmes run for years, cost tens of millions, and regularly stall at the same point. Nobody fully understands the legacy landscape that has grown over decades. That is where Qorelo comes in. We are building the AI platform for S/4HANA transformation. Qorelo reads code, processes, documentation and how the system is actually used, makes the existing landscape transparent, and delivers the fit-to-standard analysis in weeks instead of months. We take a clean core, target-architecture-first approach and carry it end to end across SAP Activate, from Discover to Realize. The knowledge stays with the customer afterwards, long after the system integrators have moved on. We have raised $3.5M from HPI Ventures, the fund tied to the institute of SAP co-founder Hasso Plattner, along with other strong backers. We already work with Fortune 500 and DAX 40 companies, including Mercedes-Benz. The role As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you are Qorelo’s technical face at the customer. You run workshops and demos on the customer’s real SAP landscape, get Qorelo connected to their systems and tools, and make sure the platform delivers on their data and their processes. Then you bring what you learned back to our engineers. You work directly with our engineering team and solution architects, report to Marino, our CTO, and spend a real share of your time with customers, both on site and remotely. What you will own SAP connectivity. RFC connections, technical users and authorisations. You make the connection work and explain it to Basis and security teams in their language. jobs.title: Applied AI Delivery Lead - NYC
jobs.jd: ABOUT THE ROLE OpenAI’s largest and most strategic customers are turning AI ambition into deployments that change how their organizations work. As a Delivery Lead, you will own delivery of priority AI initiatives for these customers, leading complex, high-impact deployments from planning through launch and adoption. You’ll establish an integrated delivery plan, drive execution against launch commitments, resolve blockers, and lead progress toward measurable customer value. You’ll partner closely with account and technical teams, FDEs, customers, and delivery partners to turn customer priorities into successful deployments. You’ll bring a clear view of delivery progress, risks, and expected outcomes, helping teams make informed decisions and connecting successful execution to consumption and growth. This is a senior, customer-facing role for someone who can move between executive conversations and practical details that determine whether a deployment succeeds. You bring technical fluency, sound judgment, and the ability to create clarity and drive action in complex, evolving environments. WHAT YOU’LL DO - Own delivery of priority AI initiatives. Lead complex customer engagements from scoping and planning through deployment, launch, and initial adoption. - Build and drive an integrated delivery plan. Establish clear scope, milestones, accountable owners, dependencies, resource needs, and success measures across customer, OpenAI, and partner teams. - Resolve blockers and drive decisions. Identify risks early, work through dependencies and resource constraints, and bring the right stakeholders together to resolve tradeoffs and keep delivery moving. - Lead launch readiness and activation. Drive rollout and enablement planning, address technical and organizational readiness gaps, and remove barriers to initial adoption and usage. - Connect delivery to customer value. Define expected outcomes and measurement approaches with customers and account teams. Track adoption and consumption, assess results against agreed baselines, and communicate the value achieved. - Provide a clear view of delivery health. Lead customer and internal delivery reviews that drive decisions and action. Communicate progress, launch confidence, risks, and implications for expected consumption and revenue timing. - Improve how we deliver. Turn customer experience into repeatable playbooks, practical tools, and actionable feedback for product and delivery teams. WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR - 7+ years of experience leading complex enterprise technology deployments, customer delivery programs, or transformation initiatives involving multiple teams and partners. - A track record of driving programs from scope through launch and adoption, with accountability for delivery commitments and measurable customer outcomes. - Strong technical aptitude, with the ability to understand AI systems, APIs, integrations, enterprise architecture, security dependencies, and deployment risks. - The ability to translate customer priorities into actionable delivery plans with clear milestones, owners, dependencies, and success measures. - Strong judgment under ambiguity, including the ability to identify material risks, navigate competing priorities, and drive timely decisions. - Experience building trust with customers and leading across teams outside your reporting line while holding stakeholders accountable to shared commitments. - Excellent communication skills, with the ability to engage executives, technical specialists, and customer operators and explain complex delivery issues clearly. - Commercial awareness and an understanding of how deployment, adoption, and consumption contribute to customer value and growth. - A practical approach to building repeatable delivery methods while adapting to the needs of individual About OpenAI OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity. We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. For additional information, please see OpenAI’s Affirmative Action and Equal Employment Opportunity Policy Statement https://cdn.openai.com/policies/eeo-policy-statement.pdf. Background checks for applicants will be administered in accordance with applicable law, and qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment consistent with those laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act, for US-based candidates. jobs.title: Applied Scientist , Fauna
jobs.jd: We are seeking an Applied Scientist to develop and optimize Visual Inertial Odometry (VIO) and sensor fusion systems for our intelligent robots. In this role, you will design, implement, and deploy state estimation and tracking algorithms that enable robots to understand their position and motion in real time, even in challenging and dynamic environments. You will own the full pipeline from algorithm development through embedded deployment, ensuring that perception systems run efficiently on resource-constrained robotic hardware. You will also leverage modern machine learning approaches to push the boundaries of classical perception methods, combining learned representations with geometric techniques to achieve robust, real-time performance. This is a deeply hands-on role. You will work directly with sensors, hardware, and real-world data, while prototyping, testing, and iterating in physical environments. The ideal candidate has strong foundations in VIO and sensor fusion, practical experience optimizing algorithms for embedded platforms, and familiarity with how modern deep learning is transforming perception. Key job responsibilities - Design and implement Visual Inertial Odometry algorithms for robust real-time state estimation on robotic platforms like Sprout - Develop multi-sensor fusion pipelines integrating cameras, IMUs, and other sensing modalities for accurate pose tracking - Optimize perception and tracking algorithms for deployment on embedded hardware (e.g., ARM, GPU-accelerated edge devices) under strict latency and power constraints - Apply modern ML-based perception techniques (learned features, depth estimation, neural odometry) to complement and improve classical geometric approaches - Build and maintain calibration, evaluation, and benchmarking infrastructure for perception systems - Collaborate with hardware, controls, and navigation teams to integrate perception outputs into the robot’s autonomy stack - Lead technical projects from research prototyping through production deployment - 3+ years of building models for business application experience - Experience in patents or publications at top-tier peer-reviewed conferences or journals - Experience programming in Java, C++, Python or related language - Experience in any of the following areas: algorithms and data structures, parsing, numerical optimization, data mining, parallel and distributed computing, high-performance computing - Hands-on experience developing and deploying Visual Inertial Odometry or visual-inertial SLAM systems - Strong understanding of multi-sensor fusion (cameras, IMUs, odometry) and state estimation (EKF, factor graphs) - Experience optimizing perception algorithms for embedded or resource-constrained hardware - Demonstrated hands-on experience with real sensor data, calibration, and physical robot platforms - Familiarity with modern ML approaches to perception (learned feature extraction, depth prediction, end-to-end odometry) - Experience using Unix/Linux - Experience in professional software development - Publication record at major robotics or computer vision conferences (e.g., ICRA, IROS, RSS, CVPR, ECCV) - Experience with real-time systems programming and performance profiling on ARM/GPU platforms - Experience with state estimation on legged robots - Experience with stereo vision systems, camera-IMU calibration, time synchronization, and sensor characterization - Track record of shipping VIO or SLAM systems to production on physical robots at scale - Experience with NVIDIA Jetson, Qualcomm RB5, or similar embedded AI platforms - Familiarity with ROS/ROS2 - Experience integrating learned perception modules (e.g., neural depth, feature matching networks) into geometric estimation pipelines -
